title: Tropical balls, geodesics and honeycomb
summary: In these notes we describe the geometry of tropical balls in $\mathbb{R}^n$ equipped with the tropical metric. After defining the tropical length of rectifiable curves (and not just piecewise linear curves), we characterize compact tropically geodesic sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Next, we describe the tropical unit ball as a zonotope, via its tropical generating set, as a union of $n+1$ tropical unit hypercubes, and as the tropical geodesic hull of the tropical unit vectors.
